title: Adaptive Variance Reduction without Knowing Oracle Smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2610.13799v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variance reduction improves the convergence rate of stochastic non-convex optimization under the average smoothness condition. Existing adaptive variance reduction methods are especially designed for average smoothness and do not adapt to standard smoothness. In this paper, we study how one algorithm can adapt to these two settings and the noiseless setting without knowing the smoothness constants or the variance bound. Given the gradient budget $T$, we develop a two-phase method. The first phase compares two independent gradients and switches to normalized momentum when their difference exceeds a threshold. This phase provides both a candidate with standard smooth and noiseless guarantees and also ensures a bounded expected function gap for the second variance reduction phase. translated_title: 无需知道Oracle光滑度的自适应方差缩减
translated_abstract: 在平均光滑性条件下，方差缩减技术可以改善随机非凸优化的收敛速率。现有的自适应方差缩减方法专为平均光滑性设计，无法适应标准光滑性。在本文中，我们研究了一个算法如何在不了解光滑常数或方差界的情况下，自适应地适应这两种设置以及无噪声设置。给定梯度预算 $T$，我们开发了一种两阶段方法。第一阶段比较两个独立的梯度，当它们的差超过阈值时切换到归一化动量。这一阶段既提供了具有标准光滑和无噪声保证的候选解，也为第二阶段的方差缩减确保了有界的期望函数间隙。由此得到的收敛速率为：在平均光滑性下为 $O(T^{-1/3})$，在标准光滑性下为 $O(T^{-1/4})$，在无噪声情况下为 $O(T^{-1/2})$。当 $T$ 未知时，w
tldr: 提出了一种两阶段自适应方差缩减算法，无需预知光滑常数或方差界，即可同时适应平均光滑性、标准光滑性和无噪声三种设置，分别达到 $O(T^{-1/3})$、$O(T^{-1/4})$ 和 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 的收敛速率。
en_tdlr: A two-phase adaptive variance reduction algorithm is proposed that adapts to average smoothness, standard smoothness, and noiseless settings without knowing smoothness constants or variance bounds, achieving rates of $O(T^{-1/3})$, $O(T^{-1/4})$, and $O(T^{-1/2})$ respectively.
